itineraries.title: The Left Bank underground walk
itineraries.description: Nine stops through the Latin Quarter and Saint-Germain-des-Prés, from the Situationists' bar on the Montagne Sainte-Geneviève to the Lettrists' café on rue du Four.

itineraries.title: Montmartre & Pigalle: cabarets and studios
itineraries.description: From the Moulin Rouge up through Pigalle's cafés, cabarets and 1920s jazz clubs to the studios and the Lapin Agile on the Butte.

itineraries.title: Latin Quarter: expatriates and May '68
itineraries.description: From the occupied Odéon and Sylvia Beach's bookshop past the Sorbonne and the barricades of rue Gay-Lussac to the flats of Orwell, Hemingway and Joyce and the Situationists' bar.

itineraries.title: Belleville & Ménilmontant: popular Paris
itineraries.description: Down the eastern hills from Piaf's legendary doorstep and Perec's vanished street to La Bellevilloise, Chevalier's birthplace and Père-Lachaise.
